fusions.name: Tidal Heave
fusions.desc: Heaves a wave through a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each has a 60% chance to be [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a swell that hits the first enemy within 7 tiles for 28 damage, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Buoyant Calm
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
